meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:
India mein **budget wedding sarees** ke liye aap online in types ko target kar sakte hain: **georgette/chiffon**, **organza**, **Banarasi look**, **silk blend**, aur **simple embroidery ya stone-work** wali sarees. Meesho par wedding sarees **₹149 se** mil rahi hain, aur kaafi options **₹299 se kam** bhi listed hain, jabki Manyavar/Mohey par daily-wear se leke wedding-style sarees roughly **₹1,499 se ₹17,999** tak dikh rahi hain.[1][11]

Aapke budget ke hisaab se practical choices:

- **₹500 ke andar:** simple georgette, chiffon, printed saree, ya light festive saree; Myntra par bhi “under 500” range ke options listed hain.[17]
- **₹500–₹2,000:** wedding guest ke liye good festive sarees; TradeIndia listings mein wedding sarees **₹1,200–₹3,500** ke range mein bhi milti hain, aur Meesho par budget picks kaafi low price par available hain.[1][18]
- **₹2,000–₹5,000:** zyada polished look ke liye silk blend, Banarasi-style, aur light embroidery wali sarees; Amrut par wedding sarees ka sale price **₹2,499** se bhi dikh raha hai.[12]
- **₹5,000 se upar:** premium festive/bridal feel ke liye Kanchipuram, Banarasi, ya designer wedding sarees; Nalli aur Kankatala jaise stores par prices **₹19,999+** aur **₹27,967+** tak ja rahe hain.[5][6]

Agar aap **bride** ho aur budget mein lena hai, to sabse safe value-for-money options usually ye hote hain:

- **Banarasi-style silk blend** for traditional wedding look
- **Organza with embroidery** for light, modern festive look
- **Georgette/chiffon with zari border** for comfort and easy drape
- **Kanchipuram-style lookalike** if you want a rich appearance without premium silk pricing

Quick buying rule:
- **Guest**: simple festive saree enough  
- **Bride**: silk blend/Banarasi-style + good blouse + matching jewelry  
- **Low budget**: Meesho, Flipkart, Myntra  
- **Mid budget**: Amrut, Libas, Sudathi, Mohey  
- **Premium**: Nalli, Kankatala, Kalki, Koskii

Agar aap chaho, main aapke **exact budget** ke hisaab se 5 best saree types aur shopping sites shortlist kar deta hoon.
